title: ITAT Mandates E-Filing of Appeals from October 1, 2026
content:
# ITAT Mandates E-Filing of Appeals from October 1, 2026

Ek important update hai. Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) ne appeals ki e-filing mandatory kar di hai. Yeh change October 1, 2026, se effective ho gaya hai.

*   **What Changed:** Ab se, ITAT mein sabhi naye appeals aur related documents exclusively ITAT ke designated e-Filing Portal ke through hi file karne honge. Physical filing ab accept nahi kiya jayega.
*   **Basis of Change:** Yeh naya framework ITAT ke Practice Note dated September 30, 2026 (F. 31-AT/Gen. Adm./Central/Delhi/2025-26) ke through announce kiya gaya hai.
*   **Key Requirements:** E-filing ke liye assessee ka PAN/TAN, valid mobile number aur email ID mandatory hain. Memorandum of Appeal aur saare supporting documents digitally sign aur verify karne honge.
*   **Scope:** Yeh mandatory e-filing Memorandum of Appeal, Cross Objections, Stay Applications, aur Miscellaneous Applications par bhi लागू होगी. Paper books aur anya documents bhi e-Filing Portal ke through hi submit karne honge for e-filed appeals.
